::: {#exm-rss-slr}
#### Residual sum of squares of a simple linear regression

A [simple linear regression](#def-slr) model
has parameter vector $\vth = (\intcoef, \coef{x})$,
so write $\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ for its residual sum of squares (@def-rss):

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})
&= \sumin \paren{y_i - \mean(x_i)}^2
&& \text{(definition of RSS)}\\
&= \sumin \paren{y_i - (\intcoef + \coef{x} x_i)}^2
&& \text{(definition of $\mean(x)$)}\\
&= \sumin (y_i - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i)^2
&& \text{(remove the inner parentheses)}
\end{aligned}
$$
:::
